name: Eternal Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Zomato Limited is one of the leading online Food Service platforms in terms of the value of food sold. Its offerings include food delivery, dining-out services, Loyalty programs, and others.As of December 31, 2020, Zomato has established a strong footprint across 23 countries with 131,233 active food delivery restaurants, 161,637 active delivery partners, and an average monthly food order of 10.7 million customers.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments
1) Food Delivery (44% in H1 FY25 vs 81% in FY22): [1] [2] The company operates Zomato, a B2C technology platform that allows customers to discover local restaurants, order food, and have it delivered through a last-mile network of independent delivery partners, with a presence in 800+ cities. The segment revenue grew by 35% YoY in H1 FY25, driven by a 24% rise in Gross Order Value (GOV). [3] [4] [5] [6]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 95.5 days to 44.9 days
cons: Stock is trading at 9.47 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of -0.64% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1,326 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 27.5 to 35.1 days.
